subject: Request to extend dry-run window for sample ingest and SSO approval
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
To: Oliver Kline <oliver@finlytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to extend dry-run window for sample ingest and SSO approval

Hi Oliver (and Jenna),

Quick note — after syncing with our ops and security teams this morning, we need an extra 48–72 hours of runway before the executive demo so we can:

- Ingest a small slice of your workload traces and sample data (to show representative latency/cost)
- Run SSO/SAML end-to-end with your IdP and validate exec accounts (we saw an intermittent assertion failure on a previous test)
- Finalize prompt-set permutations against a short evaluation harness (to avoid last-minute quality regressions)

Can we move the demo off the current date (Dec 2) to any time the week of Dec 7–10? Our ops team needs at least two full business days after we receive your sample files and SAML metadata. If travel/Exec schedules are tight, propose a pair of 60–90 minute windows and we’ll prioritize them.

I’ve looped in Laura (sales lead) and Vivek (solutions) so we can coordinate travel seats and AV for the day. We’ll attach a short runbook and a sample ingest checklist in the next message.

Thanks — really want to make sure we deliver a polished, representative demo rather than rush and risk a regression.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: runbook_v2.pdf (stub), sample_schema.csv (schema sample)

From: Oliver Kline <oliver@finlytics.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@finlytics.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to extend dry-run window for sample ingest and SSO approval

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the heads up.

Heads-up on our side: key execs are traveling Dec 1–4 and won’t be available for the original slot. Dec 7–10 should work in principle; Jenna (cc) is coordinating travel and will confirm exact exec availability tomorrow.

We’ll aim to get you a small, anonymized dataset and our SAML metadata by EOD Nov 30 (I’ll send on a secure transfer link). Two questions:

1) Are there size or format constraints for the sample? (we typically deliver a gzipped CSV)
2) Will Redwood need a separate test SP for SSO, or can we use the prod assertion URLs for the dry-run?

If we can get the dry-run moved to Dec 8 or Dec 9 afternoon PT, that would be ideal.

—Oliver
Head of Data Platform, Finlytics
oliver@finlytics.com
+1 (650) 555-1224

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to extend dry-run window for sample ingest and SSO approval

Aditya / team —

Thanks for the early flag. Ops can support the Dec 7–10 window, but we need the following delivered before we can run a full dry-run:

- A 5–10k row anonymized sample CSV (gzipped is fine) matching the attached sample_schema.csv
- SAML metadata (IdP certificate + metadata XML) for a test SP OR confirmation that we can use the prod assertion URL. We strongly prefer a test SP to avoid touching prod assertions during rehearsal.
- A short list of 6–8 representative prompt examples and the expected output tolerances (we’ll run them through the eval harness)

I attached a one-page ingest_checklist.xlsx with field expectations and the minimal validation steps. Once we have those artifacts, give us 48 hours to ingest and validate.

Suggested demo windows (PT):
- Tue, Dec 8, 13:00–15:00 PT
- Wed, Dec 9, 14:00–16:00 PT

If either works for Finlytics execs we’ll lock it and confirm AV/remote exec-seat logistics.

—Priyom
Solutions Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Oliver Kline <oliver@finlytics.com>, Jenna Morris <jenna.morris@finlytics.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 17:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to extend dry-run window for sample ingest and SSO approval

Oliver / Jenna —

Thanks for the quick reply and for offering the sample artifacts today. To confirm next steps:

1) Finlytics to share the 5–10k anonymized sample CSV (gzipped) + SAML metadata by EOD Nov 30 via the secure transfer link Oliver mentioned.
2) Finlytics to share a short set of 6–8 prompt examples (email or Drive doc) — we’ll use these for quality checks.
3) Priyom and Ops will ingest and validate; target 48 hours for validation post-delivery.
4) We’ll hold the executive demo on Tue, Dec 8 at 13:00 PT (90 minutes) pending artifact delivery; backup: Wed, Dec 9 14:00 PT.

I’ve attached the latest runbook (runbook_v2.pdf) and the sample_schema.csv (again) for your convenience. Also dropping a shared Drive link and a DocuSign invite for the standard NDA amendment (link below) — please sign the amendment so our security team can proceed with SSO tests.

If travel changes again please flag immediately; we can host a parallel remote seat for execs if travel delays cause a gap.

Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference
